newsitem.title: USA: Mass plans to sell up $250 mln of bonds in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Mass plans to sell up $250 mln of bonds in Feb.

text.p: Massachusetts plans to sell from $200 million to $250 million of general obligation bonds in February for new money, a state official said on Wednesday, adding that, at present, he did not expect to include a refunding.

"It'll all be new money unless the market moves substantially from where we are now," said Lowell Richards, assistant secretary for capital resources, explaining that bond yields would have to fall for the refunding to be worthwhile.
The state official explained that Massachusetts, which sold approximately $700 million of bonds in a refunding last autumn, typically taps the capital markets each quarter.
Massachusetts is subject to debt cap of around $900 million and has a long track record of selling bonds through competition, he added.
